reviews.text:
I've been using d'alba sunscreen lately and i quite like it
my favorite point is that cream is thin and light , quite easy to spread without feeling stuffy or heavy.after applying the skin has moisture and light shine look quite smooth not white
reviews.zh:
最近我一直用 d'alba 防曬，我幾鍾意。
我最鍾意嘅一點係，霜質地薄又輕，好易推開，唔會有悶或者重嘅感覺。塗咗之後，皮膚有水潤感，有少少光澤，睇落幾順滑，唔會泛白。

reviews.text: d'Alba products are extremely popular on the market in my home country, so I wanted to give it a try. I did not like the serum (even though it's loved by so many people) but this sunscreen feels nice. Texture is thicker compared to some other brands that I like, but it distributes quite well and absorbs quickly.
reviews.zh: d'Alba 產品喺我國家嘅市場非常受歡迎，所以我都想試吓。我唔鍾意佢嘅精華（雖然好多人都好愛），但呢款防曬用落好舒服。質地比我鍾意嘅一啲其他品牌厚身，不過都幾易推開，吸收得快。

reviews.text: I’ve been using the d’Alba Waterfull Sunscreen Anti-Aging for quite some time now, and I love it! It feels lightweight and non-sticky on the skin—perfect for daily use. It absorbs quickly, gives a nice glassy glow, and doesn’t leave a white cast. I also love that it has anti-aging benefits. I usually mix it with a pink tone-up cream, and the result looks so fresh and natural. Highly recommended for those looking for a gentle yet effective sunscreen!
reviews.zh: 我用 d'Alba Waterfull Sunscreen Anti-Aging 已經有一段時間，我好鍾意！質地輕盈，皮膚上唔黏，非常適合日常使用。吸收得快，帶出好靚嘅玻璃肌光澤，亦唔會泛白。我亦好鍾意佢有抗衰老嘅功效。我通常會同粉紅色提亮霜一齊用，效果睇落好清新自然。想搵溫和而又有效嘅防曬嘅朋友，好值得推薦！

reviews.text: This is by far my most favourite sunscreen by d’Alba. I have all of their sunscreens and the Tone up ones give me a a big white cast, while this one even tho on pricier side is very natural
reviews.zh: 呢款係 d'Alba 嘅防曬入面我最鍾意嘅一款。我全部 d'Alba 防曬都用過，Tone up 嗰啲會令我出好重嘅白粉感，而呢款雖然價錢貴少少，但係好自然。

reviews.text: A luxurious treatment for dry, chapped lips, this lip balm combines the nourishing power of Italian white truffle with a serum-like texture. It delivers intense hydration while smoothing lip lines and restoring suppleness. Lightweight yet rich, it’s perfect for daily use and layers well under lipstick without causing pilling or dryness.
reviews.zh: 專為乾燥、起皮嘅嘴唇而設嘅奢華護理。呢款護唇膏結合咗意大利白松露嘅滋養功效，質地似精華。佢可以深層補水，同時撫平唇紋，令嘴唇回復柔軟。質地輕盈但滋潤，日常使用非常適合，而且塗喺唇膏底下疊加效果好，唔會搓泥或者乾燥。

reviews.text: This sunscreen gives you a filter like effect and I often use it as a make up primer base. There is a very big difference in how glowy and smooth my base make up looks with and without this product. I have dry skin so I get dry patches easily and this product helps so much with it.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬有濾鏡效果，我經常用佢當妝前打底。用唔用呢款產品，我嘅底妝有光澤同平滑嘅效果差別好大。我皮膚乾，容易出現乾燥斑片，呢款產品幫到我好多。

reviews.text: Love how moisturizing my skin feels after applying this. It’s like sunscreen lotion almost and does make me feel overly greasy. Caution to not use too much because it can make you feel very oily.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意塗咗之後皮膚嘅保濕感。佢幾乎好似防曬乳液，而且真係會令我覺得太油膩。提醒大家唔好用太多，因為可能會令你覺得好油。

reviews.text: The texture is thin and absorbs fast to the skin. It is not moisturized as what I expected. It is kind of dry in my opinion. I have not seen the whitening effect or anti-aging effect at all. The citrus scent is really strong. My face turns a bit red after using it. It is ok to use on my neck and hand.
reviews.zh: 質地薄，吸收好快。但係冇我預期中咁保濕，我覺得有少少乾。我完全冇見到美白或者抗衰老嘅效果。柑橘香味好濃。用咗之後面有少少發紅。塗喺頸同手都可以。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
